title: Story
subtitle: 「故事／敘述／記述／軼事／故事線／歷史」，究竟是哪一種 story？
description: 「故事／敘述／記述／軼事／故事線／歷史」，究竟是哪一種 story？

words.note: 使用者提供。tale 是 story 最直接的核心近義詞之一，尤其適合虛構、民間、冒險、奇幻或帶講述感的故事。它通常比 story 更有文學、傳說或口述色彩。
words.example: The children listened to a tale about a hidden kingdom.

exercises.original: The book contains a short story about a traveller who finds a hidden city.
exercises.zh: 這本書收錄了一個旅人發現隱藏城市的短篇故事。
exercises.upgrade: tale · 故事；傳說；敘事故事

options.explanation: hidden city + literary short fiction makes tale a natural replacement.
對真實事件的記述、說法或版本，強調 factual description。 但本題的具體線索是 a literary fictional story；這句需要表達「文學／傳說式故事」。因此 account 雖然與 story 有關，仍不是此處最精確的答案。
事件被組織和講述的敘事結構，也可指更廣的解釋框架。 但本題的具體線索是 a literary fictional story；這句需要表達「文學／傳說式故事」。因此 narrative 雖然與 story 有關，仍不是此處最精確的答案。

電影、小說、劇集或遊戲中的情節線／劇情發展。 但本題的具體線索是 a literary fictional story；這句需要表達「文學／傳說式故事」。因此 storyline 雖然與 story 有關，仍不是此處最精確的答案。

exercises.original: The witness gave the police a clear story of what had happened.

options.explanation: witness + police + what happened requires a factual account, not a fictional tale.

falseSynonyms.zh: tale 常帶文學、傳說、口述或虛構色彩；story 更廣，也可指真實新聞或個人經歷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The children listened to a fairy tale. The newspaper published a story about housing costs.

falseSynonyms.zh: account 強調真實事件的記述／版本；虛構故事通常不能叫 factual account。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She gave an account of the accident. He wrote a fantasy story.

falseSynonyms.zh: narrative 更正式，強調事件如何被組織、講述或框定；story 可只是內容本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The novel uses a first-person narrative. The story is about two sisters.

falseSynonyms.zh: anecdote 必須短小而具體，常用來娛樂或說明觀點；長篇故事不是 anecdote。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He told a brief anecdote about school. The novel tells a long story spanning decades.

falseSynonyms.zh: report 是新聞／官方 factual reporting；story 可以是虛構或個人敘述。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The agency released a report. The child wrote a story.

falseSynonyms.zh: storyline 是作品內部的 plot thread；它不是一篇完整的新聞 story 或 factual account。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The series has several storylines. The newspaper ran a story on inflation.

falseSynonyms.zh: history 強調事物如何隨時間發展；story 可以只是一次事件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The museum explains the history of the port. She told a story about yesterday.

falseSynonyms.zh: story 是故事；英式英語的 storey 指建築物的一層。美式英語 story 也可表示樓層，因此要靠語境辨認。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She told a funny story. The building has six storeys.
